comment: Suites that qwen-vllm030-cpu.yml runs on Python 3.10 with an installed vLLM 0.30.0 and the pinned vllm-tt-plugin source, through scripts/ci/required_tests.py (a skip is a failure). A suite is every module under dir that matches glob, so a new test file is picked up without editing this file; require names modules that must stay (a deleted or renamed file fails the job); min_tests is a floor on the tests that must run. A suite whose directory does not exist FAILS unless absent_ok names this branch and the suite with a reason: that is the only way a suite may be missing, and the entry itself fails as soon as the directory appears (remove it then).

tp4/p2p-gemma-wp11.kvp2p: this branch carries only the CI; kvp2p/tests arrives with the connector branches, so here the run proves the install and the collection path
